gui.soloeconomy.bank.desc: Emeralds you deposit here are what you trade with, and they're safe if you die. Withdraw turns your balance back into emeralds.
gui.soloeconomy.quantity_bank_tip: How many emeralds to deposit or withdraw
merchant.soloeconomy.farmer.desc: Feeds the village. Buys your harvest and sells seeds and saplings to plant.
merchant.soloeconomy.butcher.desc: Runs the smokehouse. Buys fresh meat and fuel, sells it cooked.
merchant.soloeconomy.fisherman.desc: Works the docks. Buys the catch and whatever the sea washes up, sells tackle.
merchant.soloeconomy.woodcutter.desc: Supplies every builder in town. Buys logs, sells planks and simple woodwork.
merchant.soloeconomy.mason.desc: Builds the walls and roads. Buys stone, sand and clay, sells bricks and polished stone.
merchant.soloeconomy.smith.desc: Keeps the forge hot. Buys ore, coal and metal, sells tools and armour.
merchant.soloeconomy.collector.desc: Pays well for rare things. Gems, treasure and relics from the far corners of the world.
merchant.soloeconomy.cleric.desc: Brews potions. Buys monster drops and strange reagents nobody else wants.
merchant.soloeconomy.tailor.desc: Dresses the village. Buys wool, string and hides, sells dyes and leather clothing.
merchant.soloeconomy.librarian.desc: Keeps the records. Buys paper, ink and quills, sells books and instruments.
merchant.soloeconomy.fletcher.desc: Makes bows and arrows. Buys sticks, flint, feathers and string.
